/*common.coco.getSpecialStdCategLevel1*/
SELECT A.STD_CATEG_ID, A.CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = (SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer}) AND A.DEPTH = '1' ORDER BY 2

/*common.coco.getBuyerSpecialCategorySearch*/
SELECT A.STD_CATEG_ID, --[0] A.CATEG_NAME, --[1] A.CATEG_TYPE, --[2] DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ITEMATTR T WHERE T.STDCATEG_ID = A.STD_CATEG_ID), 0,'N','Y') AS MASTER_CHECK, --[3] DECODE(A.CATEG_TYPE, 'REG','0',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBYIT B WHERE B.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND B.BUYER = A.COM_CODE)) AS CNT, --[4] A.CATEG_PATH, --[5] A.DEPTH, --[6] A.PID, --[7] A.CATEG_SYS_CODE --[8]
,SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,3,1) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
,SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,5,2) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
,SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,8,2) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
,SUBSTR(A.STD_CATEG_ID,11,4) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = (SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer}) AND A.DEPTH = #{st_depth}
AND A.PID IN (#{st_categ_code}, (SELECT PID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND STD_CATEG_ID =#{st_categ_code}))
AND A.PID IN (#{st_stdcateg_id}, (SELECT PID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND STD_CATEG_ID =#{st_stdcateg_id}))
ORDER BY A.STD_CATEG_ID

/*common.coco.getBuyerSpecialCategorySearchReqValue*/
SELECT B.STD_CATEG_ID, B.CATEG_NAME, B.CATEG_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ITEMATTR T WHERE T.STDCATEG_ID = A.STD_CATEG_ID), 0,'N','Y') AS MASTER_CHECK, DECODE(B.CATEG_TYPE,'REG','0', ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.BUYER_ITEM_NO) FROM ICOMBYIT X WHERE X.BUYER = A.COM_CODE AND X.CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID AND X.STATUS <> 'D' AND X.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N') ) AS CNT, B.CATEG_PATH, B.DEPTH, B.PID, B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
,SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,3,1) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
,SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,5,2) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
,SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,8,2) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
,SUBSTR(B.STD_CATEG_ID,11,4) AS SUB_STD_CATEG_ID
FROM ICOMBYCA A, ICOMBYCA B WHERE A.COM_CODE = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} ) AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND B.DEPTH = #{st_depth}
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,12) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,16) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,20) = B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID = B.STD_CATEG_ID
AND A.CATEG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_searh_name} || '%'
AND A.STD_CATEG_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT Y.CATEGORY_NO FROM ICOMBYIT Y WHERE Y.BUYER = ( SELECT DISTINCT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_buyer} ) AND Y.STATUS <> 'D' AND Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND (Y.DESCRIPTION_LOC LIKE '%' || #{st_catalog} || '%' OR Y.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_catalog} || '%'))
ORDER BY B.CATEG_SYS_CODE
